paite: Namte tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung;
heading: Karkhemish Ah Aigupta Zoh In A-om
english: Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

paite: Aigupta thu, Euphrates Luipi gei a Karkhemish a om, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim, akum lina a Nebukadnezzar in anuaisiah leh Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh Neko sepaihhonte tungtang thu:
english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

paite: "Lum bemte, lum zawlte mansa in om unla, gal nawt un,
english: “Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!

paite: Sakol van unla, sakol tuang mite aw, tuang un, dal lukhu khu in dingkip unla, tei tat-hiam in sik puanak silh un.
english: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail.

paite: Bangchidan a amaute lau-le- ling a taikek a mu ka hia! Agalkap mite uh avuallel uh, baksam leng zen in atai ua, nunglam nga het lou in, ning chih ah gal alang chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Why have I seen it? They are dismayed and are turned backward. Their mighty ones are beaten down, have fled in haste, and don’t look back. Terror is on every side,” says Yahweh.

paite: Mizuanzaang ataimang thei kei, galkapmi apawt tuan kei uh, huai a mi Euphrates Luipi gei ah ahawi ua, apuk khinta uh.
english: “Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.

paite: Nile lui bang a khang kua ahia? Luipi tuikihot kimvel bang in?
english: “Who is this who rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge?

paite: Aigupta Nile lui bang in akhang a luipi tuikihot kimvel bang mai in, ka khang ding a, leitung ka luahsuak ding, khopi leh aluahte ka hihse ding," achi hi.
english: Egypt rises up like the Nile, like rivers whose waters surge. He says, ‘I will rise up. I will cover the earth. I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.’

paite: "Aw sakolte aw, nawk zel unla, aw kangtalai aw, nakpi in pang un; galdou mite'n ma phu uhenla, Ethiopia mi leh Put mi, lum tawi mite, Lud mi thalpeu zang siamte toh.
english: Go up, you horses! Rage, you chariots! Let the mighty men go out: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

paite: Huai ni ahi, Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA ni, phulak ni, amelmate tung a phu alaktheihna, namsau in agai ding a, atai ding, asisan uh taitak in adawn ding; Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N mal gam ah Euphrates Luipi gei ah mi tampi agou phengphung mai ve.
english: For that day is of the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge himself of his adversaries. The sword will devour and be satiated, and will drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

paite: Aw, Aigupta tanu siangthou, Gilead ah hohtou inla, singnai nuhchi va la in, damdawi tampi athawn in na zangta, nang a ding in damna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt. You use many medicines in vain. There is no healing for you.

paite: Namte'n na zahlakna aza ua, na kah in leitung pumpi adim hi, galhatmi leh galhatmi akiphu ua, lei ah apukkhawm uh," chi in.
english: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they both fall together.”

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong pai a, Aigupta gam ahong bawl ekdan ding thu TOUPA'N zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a agen:
heading: Nebukadnezzar Hong Paina
english: The word that Yahweh spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon should come and strike the land of Egypt:

paite: "Aigupta gam ah gen unla, Migdol ah puang un; Memphis leh Tahpanhes ah puang unla; dingkip in kigalging un; na kim a mi namsau in agaita ngal a.
english: “Declare in Egypt, publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes; say, ‘Stand up, and prepare, for the sword has devoured around you.’

paite: Bangziak a na mihatte phiatmang a om ahi ua? Adingh zou kei ua, TOUPA'N apaihkhiak ziak in.
english: Why are your strong ones swept away? They didn’t stand, because Yahweh pushed them.

paite: Mi tampi akisuisak a, ahi, akiphupuk lemlum ua, Nuaisiahna namsau taisan in kisa un, i kik ding uh, i pianna gam ah i mite kiang ah, achi uhi.
english: He made many to stumble. Yes, they fell on one another. They said, ‘Arise! Let’s go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.’

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh pen husa lian lel, ahun sehsa a paimangsak a om, chi in huai ah akikou uhi.
english: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.’

paite: Ahin a ka hin sung in chih Kumpipa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi hi, tangte lak a Tabor tang bang in tuipi chin a Karmel tang bang in ahong pai ngei ding.
english: “As I live,” says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies, “surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so he will come.

paite: Aw nang, tanu, Aigupta gam a teng, saltang ding in kibawl mai in; Memphis akisegawp dek a, teng ding om lou in akangmang ding hi.
english: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis will become a desolation, and will be burned up, without inhabitant.

paite: Aigupta bel bawngla hoihtak ahi, himahleh mal a kipan nasemmi ding hong kuan in ahong pai hi.
english: “Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come. It has come.

paite: Alak ua sepaih goihlaite bel bawngtuai vak thau bang mai ahi ua, adek uh angat ua, ataikek ua, khawl lou in, atung uah asiatna ni uh atungta, agawtna hun ding uh;
english: Also her hired men in the middle of her are like calves of the stall, for they also are turned back. They have fled away together. They didn’t stand, for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.

paite: Gulpi kitholh bang mai in husa anei a, amelmate kiton in ahong pai ua, singphuk mite bang in hei toh ahong sual uh.
english: Its sound will go like the serpent, for they will march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.

paite: Agam gammang vaksuak zoh louh ahong hihse ding uh, khaukhup sang in atamzaw ua, sim seng louh ahi uh.
english: They will cut down her forest,” says Yahweh, “though it can’t be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.

paite: Aigupta tanu azahlak ding, mallam a mi khut a matsak in a-om ding."
english: The daughter of Egypt will be disappointed; she will be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Ngai un, Thebes khua a Ammon, leh Pharaoh leh Aigupta leh apathiante, akumpipate, Pharaoh ngei leh amah muang mite ka gawt ding.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods and her kings, even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.

paite: Ahinna uh, zong mite khut ah leh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh anasem mite khut ah ka mansak ding; huai hun chiang in luah in a-om ding, nidanglai nite mah bang in," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants. Afterwards it will be inhabited, as in the days of old,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Jakob aw, ka nasempa, lau ke'nla, aw Israel, lunglel sam ke'n, ngai in, gamlapi a kipan nang ka hon hunkhe ding a, na suante leng asaltanna gam ua kipan, Jakob ahong kik ding a, muangtak in a-om hiathiat ding a, kuamah in alausak nawn kei ding uh.
heading: TOUPA'N Amite Ahondam Ding
english: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid.

paite: Jakob aw, ka nasempa, lau ke'n, ka hon ompih ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ka hon delhzakna nam tengteng ka beisak ding a, nang zaw ka hon beisak het kei ding; diktak in ka hon gawt ding a, gawt louh in ka hon khak kei ding hi.
english: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says Yahweh, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”
